annotations.title: List people in a flow step

description: List the people currently in one people-flow step, with status, due date and assigned admin — e.g. who still needs a follow-up call. Not paginated. Elvanto: peopleFlows/steps/people.

assigned.description: Only people assigned to this admin (person id), or "unassigned".

status.description: Only people with this status in the step.

name: elvanto_list_people_flow_step_people
